request.query: If an ideal generated by a family is the unit ideal and every generator times x belongs to a submodule then x belongs to the submodule

items.name: Submodule.mem_of_span_top_of_smul_mem
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (M' : Submodule R M)
  (s : Set R), Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (x : M), (∀ (r : ↑s), ↑r • x ∈ M') → x ∈ M'

items.name: Submodule.mem_of_span_eq_top_of_smul_pow_mem
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (M' : Submodule R M) (s : Set R), Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (x : M), (∀ (r : ↑s), ∃ n, ↑r ^ n • x ∈ M') → x ∈ M'

items.name: Ideal.mem_of_one_mem
items.type: ∀ {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing S] {I : Ideal S}, 1 ∈ I → ∀ (x : S), x ∈ I

items.name: Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (x : α), x ∈ Ideal.span {x}

items.name: Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring α] {x : α}, Ideal.span {x} = ⊤ ↔ IsUnit x

items.name: Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : Semiring α] (I : Ideal α) {x : α}, Ideal.span {x} ≤ I ↔ x ∈ I

items.name: Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_generator_dvd
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (S : Ideal R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal S] {x : R},
  x ∈ S ↔ Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S ∣ x

items.name: Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator_mem
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M] (S : Submodule R M)
  [inst_3 : S.IsPrincipal], Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S ∈ S
